$comment: Creatures (docs/adr/0073-creatures.md, CHARACTERS.md §11.6): animals as light server entities that wander, spawned near players by `rules` and removed far from all of them. A creature: its skinned `model` (shared/models/models.json), its walking speed (m/s), how far it wanders per walk (`wanderM`), how long it idles between walks (`idleSeconds` [min, max]), how many rows tall it is (`rows`: the open cells it needs over its ground), and the most rows it steps up (`climbRows`) or down (`dropRows`) in one step: a steeper edge (a cliff) or water stops it. A rule: the `creature`, the full blocks its ground may be (`on`), the share of the chunk columns near players that get a group (`chance`, rolled once per chunk column and face from the world seed: the same chunk always rolls the same), and the group's size (`group` [min, max]). `limits`: chunks around each player that spawn (`spawnChunks`), the distance past which a creature with no player near is removed (`despawnM`), and the most in the world (`max`). Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/creatures/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/creatures.gen.rs is stale.
